$doc: Character pack for Noomi, the reference performer (amp 1, tempo 1, lag 0): every move's base numbers are her approved v2 numbers. Values here are the approved v2's (videos/my-brain-at-2am-v2.js, stage2/face.js). Schema: composer/schemas/mallow-pack.schema.json; reader: composer/lib-node.mjs and engine/runtime/direction-runtime.js.
evidence: approved v2 'My Brain at 2 AM' (OWNER-DECISIONS D12)

art.note: The 439 px app sprites are never used; these derived hi-res assets are the approved v2 inputs (frozen).

measured.note: Alpha silhouette of art.pristine as engine/stage.js silhouette() measures it (alpha > 128, 4 % runs). The page re-measures and refuses a mismatch; tests/unit/composer-library.test.mjs re-measures the PNG in Node.

placement.note: thoughtOrigin: where thoughts emerge, behind the top of the head (world px). centre: the body's middle, which dissolving thoughts drift away from.

body.limitsNote: stretchMax is 1.4, not the plan's 1.3: the approved v2 jolt stretches Noomi to 1.386 (G-DIR deform:stretch, measured on the composed T01)

materials.note: approved v2 values (stage2/face.js), PHASE2-PLAN conflict 1; the registry's #ff6f9c tongue and screen blush apply to the other Mallows only

personality.note: amp/tempo/reactLag are relative to the reference performer, which Noomi is; reactLag is the delay added to reaction keys (s).
